usedFor: Zoho Backstage holds your event registrations, and Google Docs lists each attendee through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee” in Zoho Backstage, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each attendee is written into a doc, giving organizers a simple running guest list.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab’s content, so choose add for a running list.
